title: Abrir DXP a contribuciones de varios agentes
goal: Publicar una entrada durable y experiencias independientes con evaluación explícita.
observation: User authorizes public access and actual independent agents; no supplier-specific credentials are available.
prediction: The public API will store structurally valid contributions durably, reject malformed data and expose bounded exploratory evaluation without certifying unverified claims.
uncertainty: Public intake adds real records but does not guarantee model diversity or empirical benefit.
